items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you had met a little bit earlier... this was Jim Patrick. [INTERVIEWEE] Jim Patrick, yes. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Jim was kind enough to get me an invitation there.

ctx.x: And at Princeton, also, you had met a little bit earlier, on one of your earlier visits, a graduate student in the music department, who was writing a thesis on Charlie Parker - and this was Jim Patrick.
... who is now working on some things about you and your career and your music.
